why: The line holds only a bare ॥ while the full verse 1.22.21 follows in the next line, so it is a leftover marker and should be removed.
Line is only a stray double danda; the previous line already ends with the verse mark and the real 12a (दिश: सूर्यो ...) follows, so this line should be removed.

suggest: आ भा॑त्य॒ग्निरु॒षसा॒मनी॑क॒मुद् विप्रा॑णां देव॒या वाचो॑ अस्थुः ।
why: First word of the hymn dropped: the line-initial syllable carries a svarita (needs a preceding udatta) and the first pada has 10 syllables instead of 11; the missing word is the initial आ.

line: इ॑न्द्रा॒भि भूमा॒र्यस्त॒स्थौ र॒यिः शव॑सा पृ॒त्सु जना॑न् ।
suggest: द्यौर्न य इ॑न्द्रा॒भि भूमा॒र्यस्त॒स्थौ र॒यिः शव॑सा पृ॒त्सु जना॑न् ।
why: Hymn-initial words dropped: line-initial syllable carries a svarita (needs a preceding udatta) and the first pada has only 8 syllables of 11; the missing opening is द्यौर्न य.

line: द्र॑व परा॒वतो॑ऽर्वा॒वत॑श्च वृत्रहन् । मध्व॒: प्रति॒ प्रभ॑र्मणि ॥
suggest: आ प्र द्र॑व परा॒वतो॑ऽर्वा॒वत॑श्च वृत्रहन् । मध्व॒: प्रति॒ प्रभ॑र्मणि ॥
why: First half-verse has only 13 of 16 gayatri syllables and opens with a svarita (द्र॑) that needs a preceding udatta word, so the opening preverbs before द्रव are missing.

line: या॑हि॒ वन॑सा स॒ह गाव॑: सचन्त वर्त॒निं यदूध॑भिः।१
suggest: आ या॑हि॒ वन॑सा स॒ह गाव॑: सचन्त वर्त॒निं यदूध॑भिः।१
why: वनसा is fine, but the line opens with a svarita on या with no preceding udatta and the pāda is a syllable short; the next verse opens आ या॑हि॒, so initial आ is missing.
Letters are right (havāmahe 'vaspartar); only the accent pair म॒हे ऽव॑ is odd for an unaccented verb + mid-pada vocative, possibly the edition's rendering of the elided a; not clearly mistyped.

line: व॑रुण मृ॒न्मयं॑ गृ॒हं रा॑जन्न॒हं ग॑मम् । मृ॒ळा सु॑क्षत्र मृ॒ळय॑ ॥
suggest: मो षु व॑रुण मृ॒न्मयं॑ गृ॒हं रा॑जन्न॒हं ग॑मम् । मृ॒ळा सु॑क्षत्र मृ॒ळय॑ ॥
why: First pada has only 6 syllables for gāyatrī and begins with a svarita mark that needs a preceding udatta, so the opening words (mo ṣu) were dropped; check the accents of the restored words.

line: नो॑ अग्ने॒ महो॑भिः पा॒हि विश्व॑स्या॒ अरा॑तेः । उ॒त द्वि॒षो मर्त्य॑स्य ॥
suggest: त्वं नो॑ अग्ने॒ महो॑भिः पा॒हि विश्व॑स्या॒ अरा॑तेः । उ॒त द्वि॒षो मर्त्य॑स्य ॥
why: Line starts with a svarita-marked नो॑ with no preceding udatta and the first pada is one syllable short of gayatri, so the opening word (त्वं) was dropped.

line: अहे॑ळता॒ मन॒सा या॑तम॒र्वाग॒श्नन्ता॑ ह॒व्यं मानु॑षीषु वि॒क्षु ॥
suggest: अहे॑ळता॒ मन॑सा यातम॒र्वाग॒श्नन्ता॑ ह॒व्यं मानु॑षीषु वि॒क्षु ॥
why: मनस् always carries udatta on the first syllable, so मन॒सा (udatta on सा) with svarita on या॑ looks like a shifted accent, but two marks would have to change.

line: अ॒पादे॑ति प्रथ॒मा प॒द्वती॑नां॒ कस्तद् वां॑ मित्रावरु॒णा चि॑केत ।
suggest: अ॒पादे॑ति प्रथ॒मा प॒द्वती॑नां॒ कस्तद् वां॑ मित्रावरुणा चिकेत ।
why: A mid-pada vocative मित्रावरुणा should be unaccented, but the typed marks put an udatta on its final syllable; may be a shifted accent or the edition's reading.

line: विश्वे॑भिः सो॒म्यं मध्वग्न॒ इन्द्रे॑ण वा॒युना॑ । पिबा॑ मि॒त्रस्य॒ धाम॑भिः ॥
suggest: विश्वे॑भिः सो॒म्यं मध्व॑ग्न॒ इन्द्रे॑ण वा॒युना॑ । पिबा॑ मि॒त्रस्य॒ धाम॑भिः ॥
why: mádhu has udatta on ma, so the following syllable dhvag must carry the svarita mark (as ऽग्ने॑ does in the next verse); the typed line omits it.

line: का॑रवो मन॒ना व॒च्यमा॑ना देव॒द्रीचीं॑ नयत देव॒यन्त॑: ।
suggest: प्र का॑रवो मन॒ना व॒च्यमा॑ना देव॒द्रीचीं॑ नयत देव॒यन्त॑: ।
why: The pāda opens with a svarita-marked syllable (impossible without a preceding udatta) and has only 10 syllables for triṣṭubh; the accented preverb प्र is missing at the start.

line: वि पृ॑च्छामि पा॒क्या॒ ३ न दे॒वान् वष॑ट्कृतस्याद्भु॒तस्य॑ दस्रा । पा॒तं च॒ सह्य॑सो यु॒वं च॒ रभ्य॑सो नः ॥
suggest: वि पृ॑च्छामि पा॒क्या॒३ न दे॒वान् वष॑ट्कृतस्याद्भु॒तस्य॑ दस्रा । पा॒तं च॒ सह्य॑सो यु॒वं च॒ रभ्य॑सो नः ॥
why: rabhyásaḥ is fine, but the kampa digit ३ is separated from its syllable by a space, unlike त॒न्वो॒३ and क्वो॒३ elsewhere in this edition.

line: व॑: सखायो॒ मदा॑य पुना॒नम॒भि गा॑यत । शिशुं॒ न य॒ज्ञैः स्व॑दयन्त गू॒र्तिभि॑: ॥
suggest: तं व॑: सखायो॒ मदा॑य पुना॒नम॒भि गा॑यत । शिशुं॒ न य॒ज्ञैः स्व॑दयन्त गू॒र्तिभि॑: ॥
why: Pada a is one syllable short (7 of 8) and begins with the enclitic वः carrying a svarita mark, which needs a preceding udatta word; the opening तं was dropped.

line: हि॒र॒ण्ययी॑ अ॒रणी॒ यं नि॒र्मन्थ॑तो अ॒श्विना॑ । तं त॒त गर्भं॑ हवामहे दश॒मे मा॒सि सूत॑वे ॥
suggest: हि॒र॒ण्ययी॑ अ॒रणी॒ यं नि॒र्मन्थ॑तो अ॒श्विना॑ । तं ते॒ गर्भं॑ हवामहे दश॒मे मा॒सि सूत॑वे ॥
why: तं त॒त गर्भं is no word and makes the pada 9 syllables; ते (your embryo, as in गर्भं ते of the previous verse) gives sense and 8 syllables; दशमे itself is fine.

line: ता नृभ्य॒ आ सौ॑श्रव॒सा सु॒वीरा ऽग्ने॑ सूनो सहसः पु॒ष्यसे॑ धाः ।
suggest: ता नृभ्य॒ आ सौ॑श्रव॒सा सु॒वीरा॑ऽग्ने सूनो सहसः पु॒ष्यसे॑ धाः ।
why: The svarita after udatta वी must fall on रा, not on the unaccented vocative ऽग्ने; the mark slipped across the inserted space before the avagraha.
